info.title: NooDS U
info.author: michyprima
info.details:
NooDS U is a DS and GBA emulator for the Wii U, built to run well on real hardware. It's a Wii U-only fork of NooDS by Hydr8gon.

Play with the top screen on the TV and the bottom one on the GamePad, or use a Pro or Classic Controller. Sync to Display gives smoother motion, and you can keep the whole ROM in RAM for fast access. There's also a simple settings menu, a file browser, and an optional Screen Frame that surrounds the screens with the look of a DSi.

NooDS U is alpha software, so some games may hang, crash or misbehave. Licensed under GPLv3.

AI use: Co-written with AI. AI also used for: icon/banner art, description text.
